module: Facade of the world editor's Terraform tool. It stores five settings (domain of influence, margin, falloff, roughness, noise scale) as editor preferences, manages the polygon drawn by the user and triggers terrain terraforming (editor/terraform/terraform) from sources fetched by editor/terraform/fetchSources (roads, etc.) in a polygon or in the selection. A modder uses it to terraform by script or to read/modify the settings.
usage:
local t = extensions.editor_terraformTool
t.setDOI(150)
t.setMargin(6)
t.terraformSelection()
notes: Default values from the code: DOI 100 m, margin 5.0 m, falloff 1.5 m, roughness 0.4, scale 0.5 (the last two in [0, 1]).
Slider bounds: DOI 1 to 500 m, margin 0 to 20 m, falloff 1 to 5 m.
Settings are read with editor.getPreference('terraformTool.general.<name>') and equal the default value if the preference is absent (nil or false).
The terraforming functions actually modify the terrain; they assume the editor is initialized.

getDOI.desc: Returns the terraforming domain of influence (in meters), read from the terraformTool.general.domainOfInfluence preference (default 100).

getMargin.desc: Returns the lateral margin (in meters) around the sources, preference terraformTool.general.margin (default 5.0).

getFalloff.desc: Returns the decay distance (falloff, in meters), preference terraformTool.general.falloff (default 1.5).

getRoughness.desc: Returns the noise roughness, preference terraformTool.general.roughness (default 0.4, range [0, 1]).

getScale.desc: Returns the noise scale, preference terraformTool.general.scale (default 0.5, range [0, 1]).

setDOI.desc: Saves the domain of influence in the editor preferences.

setMargin.desc: Saves the lateral margin in the editor preferences.

setFalloff.desc: Saves the decay distance in the editor preferences.

setRoughness.desc: Saves the noise roughness in the editor preferences.

setScale.desc: Saves the noise scale in the editor preferences.

getPolygon.desc: Returns the current polygon (delegates to editor/toolUtilities/polygon).

returns.desc: Current polygon (structure defined by the polygon module).

isPolygonExist.desc: Tells whether a valid polygon exists (poly.isPolygonValid).

returns.desc: true if the polygon is valid.

handleTerraformingPolygon.desc: To be called every frame of the UI: handles the user's polygon drawing and launches terraformPolygon when they confirm.

terraformPolygon.desc: Fetches all supported sources in the polygon (fetchSources.getAllSourcesInPolygon) then calls terraformToSources with the current settings (DOI, margin, falloff, roughness, scale).

polygon.desc: Polygon in which to search for sources (inferred from code).

terraformSelection.desc: Fetches the supported objects of the editor selection (fetchSources.getAllSourcesInSelection) and terraforms the terrain around them with the current settings.

onEditorRegisterPreferences.desc: Editor hook: registers the terraformTool preference category and its general subcategory (domainOfInfluence as int, margin, falloff, roughness, scale as float) with their bounds.
